value.title: Swarm of the Bartoll
value.synopsis: The Earth Federation Army prepares to unveil their newest mech, the VTX-001 Bartoll. On the day of their unveiling, the Bartolls attack Earth. The ATX and SRX teams are dispatched to defeat the Bartolls, and upon capturing one makes a startling discovery regarding the ODE system.

value.title: People = Parts
value.synopsis: After learning the history of the ODE system, the ATX team is sent to investigate Wong Heavy Industries while the SRX team stays to protect the ship. During the mission, the teams discover the true operating location of the Bartolls and heads to it.

value.title: Captive of the Maze
value.synopsis: The final battle erupts in outer space as the ATX Team, SRX Team, and Cybuster engage the Bartolls near their main operating facility "Hellgate". The teams encounter five new Bartolls during the battle and Kyosuke and Excellen finally reach the core of the Hellgate.
